item.title: The Unsung Heroes of the Farm: Meet the Portage County Working Cats
item.description: This week, we’re shining a spotlight on a remarkable group of felines that often go unnoticed but play a vital role in rural life—the Portage County Working Cats. These fearless ferals come from various rural and residential areas, often too timid to approach humans. Their journey begins at The Humane Society, where they receive essential health evaluations, spaying or neutering, and necessary immunizations.T.K. item.title: SIGN UP FOR VENISON! Courtesy of the Waushara Archers
item.description: SIGN UP FOR VENISON!If you are interested in receiving a deer hunted by a member, please call or text 920-229-7500. Provide your name, address, and phone number. You will be added to a waiting list, and a representative from the Waushara Archers Club will contact you when a deer is available. We will coordinate the delivery of the deer to you. Please note that you will need to handle the processing of the deer, or you can opt to pay for processing at a facility of your choice. There is no charge

item.title: Meet Skyler White: The Sweet Brown Tabby Cat Looking for Her Forever Home
item.description: Skyler White is a gentle soul wrapped in a beautiful brown tabby coat. At 12 years old, she has a calm and loving nature that shines through her striking green eyes. Despite facing some challenges in her life, Skyler remains affectionate and ready to share her heart with a family that will cherish her. This special needs cat is looking for a forever home where she can enjoy peaceful days filled with naps and gentle pets.Sherrie from the Humane Society of Portage County talks with T.K. About Skyl
